claim_text: The Amazon rainforest produces 20% of the world's oxygen
source_text: Although the Amazon is a significant oxygen producer through photosynthesis, its net contribution to atmospheric oxygen is offset by decomposition processes.
notes: Source confirms oxygen production but qualifies the 20% figure; high confidence

claim_text: Glacier retreat has accelerated by 300% since 2000
source_text: Alpine glacier mass loss rates measured between 2000-2019 were approximately double the 1970-2000 rates in most regions.
notes: Source confirms acceleration but at 2x not the claimed 3x (300%); partial support

claim_text: Hydropower accounts for 16% of global electricity generation
source_text: Nuclear power supplied approximately 10% of global electricity in 2022, making it the second-largest low-carbon source after hydropower.
notes: Source mentions hydropower but focuses on nuclear; insufficient data to confirm 16% figure

claim_text: Wildfire seasons are 20% longer than in the 1970s
source_text: The global wildfire season has lengthened by approximately 18.7% since 1979 due to climate-change-driven drying trends.
notes: Source confirms similar figure (~18.7% vs 20%) but low support score from weak evidence extraction

claim_text: Geothermal energy is the most reliable renewable source
source_text: Energy storage technology has improved significantly, enabling better integration of intermittent renewable sources into grid systems.
notes: Source discusses energy storage not geothermal reliability; no entailment evaluated

claim_text: Tidal energy has the potential to meet 10% of global demand
source_text: Tidal stream and barrage technologies could theoretically provide up to 120 TWh annually, representing roughly 0.5% of current global electricity consumption.
notes: Source indicates 0.5% not 10%; direct contradiction of the quantitative claim

claim_text: Green hydrogen costs will fall below $2/kg by 2030
source_text: Recent analyses suggest green hydrogen production costs could reach $1.50-2.50/kg by 2030 depending on electrolyzer costs and renewable energy prices.
notes: Source range includes $2/kg but also higher; partially supports the target

claim_text: Electric vehicles have lower lifetime emissions than ICE vehicles
source_text: A comprehensive lifecycle analysis found that EVs produce 50-70% fewer emissions than comparable ICE vehicles when charged from renewable sources.
notes: Low metadata match; no entailment evaluation; source data supports but pipeline cannot confirm without entailment
